Visitor Management System Architecture

Version 1.0 | Status: Draft

1. Introduction

The VMS is a lightweight, secure web application designed to replace manual reception logs. It ensures 100% accountability via audit trails and protects PII through automated lifecycle policies.

11. Database Design

TableKey Constraints
VisitHistoryCHECK (check_out > check_in), Unique Index on (visitor_id) WHERE status='Checked-In'
EmployeesFK to Users, is_active trigger validation

17. Security Design

  • Hybrid Auth: RLS enforced via Postgres context app.current_user_id.
  • Double-Token: 15m Access Token + HttpOnly Refresh Token.
  • PII Privacy: Nightly anonymization for data > 30 days.
  • Media: Direct-to-S3 with 14-day lifecycle.
